Table of the indicators

Source: R/fct_plots.R
render_index_table.Rd

Every indicator of indicators(), with its unit, whether it is for countries or regions, a link to its dataset in the database of Eurostat and its definition.

Usage

render_index_table()

Value

A DT table.

Examples
